target_policy: Hard CE uses each frozen TRAIN gold target. Teacher soft distributions are cached only at those answer-token positions; no dev/test labels enter training.
matched_control: reports/coverage-v3/gold242-*; same TRAIN IDs, seeds, optimizer steps, LoRA rank/modules and learning rate, but historical control uses hard CE only.
development_comparison: Report all three seeds and paired changes against the matching historical gold242 seed. Do not select a seed.
decision_boundary: The 74-row dev has been reused and is development evidence only. Do not claim independent confirmation or deployment quality from this run.
external_policy: No external inference is authorized by this protocol; define a new untouched evaluation before any confirmation claim.
budget_note: One pass over 242 TRAIN rows per seed. Report supervised tokens and cache bytes; complete-vocabulary float16 cache cost is part of the result.
